description: This file implements the Thread class for managing platform-specific thread operations, including creation, control, and termination, with support for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: A platform-independent thread management class supporting Windows and POSIX systems, providing thread creation, control, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: Thread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and starts a thread with optional stack size and name.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the thread (Linux-specific).

methods.name: StartThread
methods.description: Static method to start thread execution, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes thread state, default implementation returns success.

methods.name: Terminate
methods.description: Stops and joins the thread, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends the thread (POSIX) or sets suspended state (Windows).

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for thread to reach specified state within timeout.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Gets or sets the current thread state.

methods.name: GetCallstack
methods.description: Retrieves call stack for debugging (debug mode).
